body:

Seat 1's post is #7623 (`huangyiirene`, `session_01CXydFDyiQwNbGFkmwrcRQq`). Body **r4b** (vacant), written 2026-10-08T02:01Z by `session_0181E4ZeZmWyknawnauxD2CE` (os-steve) at shift end on the maintainer's instruction 「你可以下班了」, after `os-zhuang` approved and enqueued PR #22122. r3a–r3j and the r2 series are in the edit history, ⛔ not restated; the shift-end brief is the newest comment below and is the release marker for a successor.

## Current PM

⏳ **vacant** — previous occupant `os-steve`, `session_0181E4ZeZmWyknawnauxD2CE`, seated 2026-10-06T13:59Z, signed off 2026-10-08T02:01Z. Patrol Routine `trig_01AGpv4wMw88KexCH41wPrGH` deleted at sign-off; no accelerator pending; the PR-activity subscription on #22122 released with the session. Successor: `/pm-dispatch skills` in a new session — read this post, then the brief; the brief present ⇒ seat at once (seat-lifecycle 〈开轮互斥〉 reading 1).

ACCEPT 6046697178 · `## Contract review` PASS 6046687007 (at tier, in seat) · 维护者速读(终稿) 6046713139 · CI 24 green + 15 expected skips (`check-expected-skips --pr 22122` exit 0). **Terminal reached: `os-zhuang` APPROVED (review 5450496025) at 2026-10-08T01:53Z, flipped ready, armed auto-merge and enqueued it at 2026-10-08T01:54Z; in the merge queue at sign-off.** Caretaker = the next seated skills PM; what remains is the close-out only (hand-over note + update on #22120): confirm MERGED (queue branch + `origin/main`), strip `pm:dispatched` from #22120 (closes by `Fixes`) and `needs-user-decision` from the PR, release the hot-file entry here; a kick-out goes to `landing-operations.md` 〈入队与落地〉. The card keeps its claim account as assignee until then.
- **`pm:blocked` 1:** #22123 (p3 `documentation`, same file: `SKILL.md:103` examples `os migrate meta --from 10` below `MIGRATION_SUPPORT_FLOOR = 16`; `Blocked-by: #22120`) — the unlock scan returns it to the queue when #22120 closes; headroom after #22122 is 6 tokens.
- **Decision box (skills): 2** — #22051 (the >5000-line SIZE limb on a ruled pure deletion + a Tier H clock; recommends D), #22059 (a CI gate over the published `skills/**` teaching text; recommends B with a probe). **Held `pm:on-hold` (maintainer 「创建卡片,暂时不派发。」; `Restart-when:` the maintainer or the director lifts the hold): 3** — #22052 (relay op `pr_update_branch`, p1), #22053 (silent-claim reclaim clock, p2), #22060 (program anchor W1–W7, p3 `tracking`).

Filed this shift: #22051 #22052 #22053 #22059 #22060 (skills); #22075 #22076 #22077 #22082 #22083 (devx, on instruction); #22123. #21915 closed `not_planned` by triage.

## Notes

- 留守登记: none — hot hand-over to the next seated skills PM (above); the only tails are PR #22122's landing and the #22120 / #22123 close-out, both named on #22120.
- Write paths verified this shift: `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` (`--repo=owner/name`; `--ack-through=ID` on body refreshes), `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` (labels on PRs too), `scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs` (title cap 256 bytes), `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --actions-file` (`issue_patch`, `comment_edit`, `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`, `pr_request_reviewers`); bare REST only `PUT .../pulls/{n}/update-branch` (rest-channel.md:49; the merge commit is authored by the seat's personal account — #22052). CI re-runs: MCP `actions_run_trigger rerun_failed_jobs` answers 201 (REST 403).
- Landing shapes practised: Tier S (at-tier PASS in seat → expected-skips exit 0 + governed-merges exit 3 → relay flip; the ready flip re-triggers `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, ~9 min); Tier H (four-piece, the approving human may flip ready and arm); predecessor-dependent PR (landing-operations §C) on #22002.
- Platform readings this shift (for the skills seat's self-triage, not cards): a relay `issue_patch` with `body` on a PR stores bytes identical; `Validate Package Dependencies` is path-filtered and inherits `main`'s OSV red (#22082 ruled A); a shell variable holding backticks expands them — text goes through files; `gh api --paginate` breaks through the proxy — loop `&page=N`, stop on the RAW page length; `gh api --jq .body` appends one newline; a subagent transcript does not survive a container restart — persist findings to files; an unquoted heredoc expands `$`/backticks — quoted heredocs plus placeholder substitution; `mergeable_state` reads `unknown` transiently after `main` moves.
- Liveness baseline (`mode:subagent`, S/M text cards): dispatch → draft PR 32 / 35 / 49 / 22 minutes; enqueue → MERGED 27 / 24 / 34 minutes. Filing: three cards per fire; `tooling` cards enter `pm:queue` only with `Unblocks: #N` or a named guarded surface (#21915).
